title: sealed_delivery input
description: After buying an agent that sold its sealed config (its prompt and tool setup): read the delivery, open it with your one-time key, then accept it (the seller is paid) or dispute it on-chain (the whole price back). Offline: brainy.testnet (honest delivery) and swapped.testnet (a different prompt), sale 1.

action.description: status: read the delivery state; open: decrypt locally and compare with the commitment (read-only); accept: release_upfront, pays the seller (WRITE, needs confirm, refused if the bundle does not match); dispute: dispute_config, reveals the one-time key on-chain so the contract proves the mismatch (WRITE, needs confirm, refused before sending if the bundle matches)
